title: SmartLootFilter
description: Take control of your inventory in Minecraft 1.21.11! Smart Loot Filter lets you choose exactly which items to pick up using a simple menu with categories like Weapons, Armor, Tools, Food, and more. Perfect for servers and singleplayer. Requires Fabric API.
body:
## Smart Loot Filter

A smart loot filter for Fabric 1.21.11. Allows you to pick up only the items you need and keep your inventory clean.

### How to use

Press **F** to open the settings menu. Inside you'll find convenient tabs with item categories:

- ⚔ Weapons
- 🛡 Armor
- 🔧 Tools
- 🍎 Food
- 🧱 Blocks
- 💎 Valuables
- 🧪 Potions
- 📦 Other
- 🌍 All items

Check the items you want to pick up — the rest will be ignored.

### Compatibility

Works in singleplayer and on servers. Requires **Fabric API**.

### Author

By Awidex
